summary: The explicit count prefix 5 selects a five-turn SLIMED timeout, but the existing js/wizcmds.js SLIMED arm still discards its message and does not call potion.c:make_slimed. C applies the timeout and prints “You are turning into slime.”; JavaScript leaves it unset, causing the sole mismatch at step 18. This case confirms the same whole-function make_slimed port and caller wiring as the default-duration case, with the requested duration fixed at 5 rather than the default 30. The command does not spend five game turns, so slime expiration is not reached here.

source.branch: For #wizintrinsic with a leading count prefix of 5 and the SLIMED menu choice, wiz_intrinsic() uses amt=5 instead of DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_INCR=30. This recording starts with oldtimeout=0, so C computes newtimeout=5 and calls make_slimed(5, "You are turning into slime."). The whole make_slimed() function must set the requested timeout while preserving non-timeout intrinsic bits, update the status line and print a non-null message only when the active state changes, and on cure remove the delayed SLIMED killer and any fake green-slime monster appearance. The recipe ends after the command/menu selection; it does not spend five turns or reach timeout expiration.
callers: Selected production route: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1965-1966 registers wizintrinsic -> nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:wiz_intrinsic() (1039-1043) -> make_slimed(newtimeout, buf). The count prefix 5 changes newtimeout from this caller’s default 30 to exactly 5. JavaScript route is js/cmd.js:runIntrinsicCommand (3520-3523) -> js/wizcmds.js:wiz_intrinsic() (425-429); replace that branch’s discarded message and note_unported gap with the ported helper call.

Preserve each outer function’s separate incomplete status.

Direct C callers without the corresponding JavaScript source branch remain explicit outer gaps: timeout.c:stoned_dialogue, uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_drin, and uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slim. stoned_dialogue is the direct timeout caller; done_timeout is not.
dependencies: potion.c:set_itimeout() is already implemented as js/potion.js:set_itimeout() (469-470); it overwrites only TIMEOUT bits.

The cure branch consumes end.c:find_delayed_killer(SLIMED) as end.c:dealloc_killer() input (potion.c:209-210); both are already implemented in js/end.js (1715-1721, 1746-1755). Preserve this return-valued dependency in the whole-function port.
The active transition calls pline() only when msg is non-null (potion.c:204-208); the existing JavaScript message path is ttyPline(). The selected caller supplies a message.
